units: <cite ref="Shabbat 61a:16">Ib. 61ᵃ</cite> <he>ק׳ של כתב</he> a written amulet; <he>ק׳ של עיקרין</he> an amulet containing roots; Y. ib. VI, 8ᵇ top <he>ק׳ … בעשבים</he>. Ib. <he>נאמן … ק׳ זה וכ׳</he> a physician may be relied upon when he says, this amulet is approved, I cured with it &c.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 45:2">Gen. R. s. 45</cite> <he>ק׳ היא צריכה</he> she (Sarah) needs an amulet (for sterility).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4">Num. R. s. 12</cite> <he>יהא הק׳ הזה עליך וכ׳</he> wear this amulet that the evil eye may no longer have power over thee; Tanḥ. Naso 17; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 5:1">Pesik. R. s. 5</cite>; a. fr.—[Tanḥ. l. c. <he>נתן לה קמיעה</he>, corr. acc.]—Pl. <he>קְמֵיעִים</he>, <he>קְמֵיעִין</he>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 77:3">Gen. R. s. 77</cite> <he>הוא בא אליך וחמשה ק׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>וחמש</he>) he (Jacob) comes to thee provided with five amulets: his own merit, his father’s merit &c.; a. e.
